plan.title: Complete common-report adapter acceptance and compatibility documentation

criteria.description: A combined relay, surface and policy project has deterministic common reports; missing baseline blocks despite valid relay, while NOT VERIFIED and D13 remain explicit adapter policies.
Relay success cannot bypass other required checks or NOT VERIFIED pre-push policy.
Surface adapter matrix remains covered across missing, unapproved, stale, changed, busy and approved states.
Policy adapter matrix preserves shrink-only approval and new finding rejection.

limitations: Completes NARU-018 after preparatory slices 018.1 through 018.4.
No claim of atomic filesystem snapshot, relay authentication, actual Git push or new live agent-session verification.
No independent review claimed; MVP independent acceptance remains NARU-022.
